notes.title: Divine Birds arrives NOW!
notes.notes:
Tons of new, FREE content

- New Divine Bird cards
- New runes exclusive to those cards
- New bosses you need to defeat to get each card
- A region with new areas (Eden York)
- A new final boss in the new region

Also, the game is available on Switch too now!

notes.title: Amazing card game you haven't played (yet) – Huge thanks to Fuzz Force
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

As we wrap up our announcement for the Divine Birds expansion, we wanted to take a moment to shout out an amazing dev who has supported us along the way. If you love card games and creature collectors, check it out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swaps/

Big thanks to Fuzz Force for their support and all-around awesomeness. Indie games thrive because of this community, and we’re grateful to be part of it!

Go give Isle of Swaps some love, buy the game! 

If you already have Perfect Hand of Nostalpix, you can get a bundle discount too!

Know any other hidden gem card games? Drop it in the comments!

With ❤️ Perennial Hearts

notes.title: "Divine Birds" update coming to Steam April 3rd! Limited time sale continues!
notes.notes:
Proud to announce the "Divine Birds" update is coming to Steam on April 3rd!

This means users will be able to enjoy all the content in Perfect Hand of Nostalpix on both Steam and the Nintendo Switch.

Here is the Steam trailer of the new update!

[previewyoutube=s9ZHlaMYyTo;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be announcing more details on the update soon!

Pick up the game now while the discount is still going!

And... We have partnered up with Isle of Swaps to provide a new bundle for Perfect Hand of Nostalpix! You can see the new bundle on the Perfect Hand of Nostalpix Steam page. The discount also applies to the bundle, so get it while it's hot!

notes.title: The Perfect Hand of Nostalpix is coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
The Perfect Hand of Nostalpix is coming to Nintendo Switch on April 3!

Here’s the trailer for the Nintendo Switch version:

[previewyoutube=3dsx4ewtTak;full][/previewyoutube]

Nintendo eShop link for The Perfect Hand of Nostalpix:
https://store-jp.nintendo.com/item/software/D70010000090128

As for the sequel, Card Nova Hyper, its release, initially planned for 2024, has been delayed to further refine the game and deliver the best experience possible. Like The Perfect Hand of Nostalpix, we’re aiming for a console release as well. We apologize for the delay and ask you to add Card Nova Hyper to your wishlist if you haven’t yet:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197330/CARD_NOVA_HYPER/

For those without a Nintendo Switch, don’t worry! We’ll be sharing more news for you soon.

notes.title: Good News and Bad News about the Perfect Hand of Nostalpix Demo!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We’ve got some news about the Perfect Hand of Nostalpix demo. It’s only going to be available until the end of Thursday UTC. For people living in Japan like me, that means Friday at 9:00 AM JST.

[b]Why is the demo only available for a short period?[/b]
Thanks to your awesome feedback, we're working on making the demo even better. We want to give you the best experience possible, and we think these changes are going to make a big difference. Since save data won't carry over between the two demos, we are first taking down the current demo so that no one is surprised when the save data gets wiped out.

[b]What’s next?[/b]
Stay tuned! We're hard at work on the improved demo, and we can’t wait for you to check it out.

A big shoutout to everyone who went out of their way to compliment the game. Your support means the world to us!

If you haven't played yet, don’t miss out on the current demo before it’s gone! Download and play now, and let us know what you think.

Happy gaming
